Class InternshipViewer

java.lang.Object
Models.Utility_Classes.InternshipViewer
public class InternshipViewer extends Object
Utility class for viewing and managing internship listings. Provides functionality to display internships, filter by availability, submit applications, and request withdrawals.

This class acts as a facade for internship-related operations, simplifying the interaction between students and internship opportunities.
